_comment: Preferred audio devices, matched case-insensitively against Windows friendly names, first match wins; no match falls back to the Windows default. "default" = always the current Windows default device. Used by the engine and the audio test tools. Headset setup: JBL in stereo (A2DP 'Hovedtelefoner', not the 'Headset' hands-free endpoint, which drops to phone quality) + the DJI Mic 2 receiver over USB-C. 'USB Audio Device' is not the DJI (live run 4); the DJI only shows up as an audio input when its receiver is plugged in as audio, not as a USB drive.
